cohort: Neonates with hyperbilirubinemia whose medical records were available from Annisa Medical Center Hospital, Bandung Regency in 2019.
finding: The prevalence rate of hyperbilirubinemia was 21.2%, with preterm male neonates being predominantly prevalent among those affected, despite having normal birth weight and vaginal delivery mode.
mod_finding: Among neonates with hyperbilirubinemia, 69.5% were born through vaginal delivery.
birth_weight: Includes neonates of various birth weights, with 85.6% of those with hyperbilirubinemia being of normal weight.
gest_age: Includes neonates of various gestational ages, with 51.5% of those with hyperbilirubinemia being preterm.
